in practical problems, many random phenomena involve multiple variables, and there is a certain correlation between these variables. multivariate statistical analysis is a discipline that uses mathematical statistical methods to explore the statistical regularity of relevant multivariate data through the analysis and processing. people judge whether items purchased online are genuine by analyzing the various index values of items purchased from physical stores and online stores. this can be summarized as the test problem of the mean vector in multivariate statistics. doctors use the patient's various examination data to diagnose what kind of disease the patient suffers from. this can be solved by the discriminant analysis method in multivariate statistics. through multivariate pollution dye data divides an area into several polluted areas for targeted treatment, which requires the use of cluster analysis methods in multivariate statistics. with the advent of the big data era, people urgently need to convert high-dimensional data into low-dimensional data for processing. the principal component analysis and factor analysis methods in multivariate statistics study dimensionality reduction problems. multivariate statistical analysis can be said to be a subject with wide applications. we hope that students majoring in statistics, as well as students in other disciplines such as economics, sociology, and engineering who need to conduct multivariate data analysis in research, will join the study of this course!
